title: Grateful Dead Live at Shrine Exposition Hall on 1968-08-23
source: Vault Master 8-track Reel > Studio 2-track Mixdown (Dan Healy) > CAS > DAT

ai_review.summary: Highly regarded soundboard mix that may be the best source for this show
ai_review.review: The lone reviewer gives a perfect five‑star rating and asks whether this eight‑track soundboard mix is the superior version compared to another SBD release, indicating strong confidence in its audio fidelity. No musical performance details are provided, so the assessment focuses on the recording’s potential excellence.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one brief, five‑star review that praises the source but gives no concrete performance details; rating reflects high perceived audio quality but limited evidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewer implies this SBD 8‑track mix may be the best sounding version, though no specific descriptors (e.g., clarity, balance) are given.
